LNL: the MX17 arms around a lithium target, to scale

A ~1 MeV proton beam from AN2000 or CN on a sub-micron lithium film in a thin carbon-fibre chamber, with the four n_TOF arms at their as-built spacing. The other two tabs show the spectrometers that already ran this reaction, at the same scale. Everything is in centimetres. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. The events are illustrative draws from the same toy as lnl/lnl_rates.py.

Events (illustrative)

X17 from ⁸Be* at rest, m = 16.7 MeV; IPC from the M1 virtual-photon spectrum (dN/dln M ∝ k³); cosmics cos²θ from above. A pair "counts" when its two leptons land in two different Micromegas.

Numbers (4π, before any detector)

Yields from lnl_rates.py: Zahnow 1995 σ (EXFOR A0639) split into the two 1⁺ resonances + direct capture, PSTAR stopping. X17 at the ATOMKI ratio R = 5.8×10⁻⁶ of γ₀. IPC with the Born α (3.5–4.4×10⁻³).

Sources: MX17 arm geometry from MX17_Full_Geant SimConfig.hh (MM faces 20.40 / 20.45 cm, active 39.9 × 36.0 cm, pinwheel shifts; SiPM wall 11 cm behind the mylar; 20 × 30 × 2 cm plastics; LS slabs 45 × 45 cm). LNL clovers: Góngora-Servín et al., APPB Supp 18, 2-A13 (2025): four 2 × 2 clovers of 10 × 5 × 5 cm EJ-200 E blocks behind 20-bar ΔE layers, 12.5–13 cm from the target, at 30°, 165°, 240°, 315°. ATOMKI: Gulyás et al., NIM A 808, 21 (2016): 24 cm carbon-fibre tube, r = 3.5 cm, 0.8 mm wall; target on a 50 × 5 mm, 10 µm Al strip; Ta Faraday cup 15 cm behind; ΔE 38 × 45 × 1 mm and E 78 × 60 × 70 mm at 0°, 60°, 120°, 180°, 270°. Telescope radii are read off their Fig. 2, so they are approximate. Machines: LNL "Beams available AN2000–CN" and the 2026 CN paper (arXiv:2605.12005). Everything else: x17_facility_search/lnl/.
